prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: O=C(CCCCCCNC(=O)c1cnc(N(c2ccccc2)c2ccccc2)nc1)NO
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL1865

Assay A:
  Description: Inhibition of human HDAC6 preincubated for 15 mins followed by substrate addition by fluorescence-based assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Assay B:
  Description: Inhibition of full length human HDAC6 using FAM-labeled acetylated peptide as substrate by electrophoretic mobility shift assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "NOT_COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.55, "error_class": "assay_method", "reason": "The two assays use fundamentally different detection methods (fluorescence-based enzymatic assay vs. electrophoretic mobility shift assay) with different substrates (generic fluorogenic substrate vs. FAM-labeled acetylated peptide), which can lead to different apparent IC50 values due to differences in substrate Km, assay kinetics, and readout sensitivity, making agreement within 0.3 log units unlikely."}

parsed.reason: The two assays use fundamentally different detection methods (fluorescence-based enzymatic assay vs. electrophoretic mobility shift assay) with different substrates (generic fluorogenic substrate vs. FAM-labeled acetylated peptide), which can lead to different apparent IC50 values due to differences in substrate Km, assay kinetics, and readout sensitivity, making agreement within 0.3 log units unlikely.
